name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan's journey in motorsport began, not in the pits, but in the engineering labs of Trinity College Dublin. Armed with a degree in mechanical engineering, he initially focused on automotive design before a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited his passion for the track. He quickly transitioned into a race engineer role, honing his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics.

After a decade of working his way through various racing series, from Formula Ford to GT racing, Declan's leadership potential became evident. He joined Triple Eight Race Engineering five years ago, initially as a senior engineer, and quickly rose through the ranks. As Head of Operations, he emphasizes meticulous planning, clear communication, and fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. His calm demeanor under pressure and sharp analytical mind make him a valuable asset to the team.

Declan distinguishes himself through his ability to bridge the gap between the technical and operational aspects of racing. He possesses a rare talent for translating complex engineering concepts into actionable strategies, ensuring that the entire team is aligned and working towards a common goal. He brings an analytical and data-driven approach to every aspect of the role.
